why: Private resort campground with no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py) and not a Good Sam Park; the operator posts no nightly rate and its booking engine had no inventory for any 2027 date (read 2026-11-22), but every 2026 camper report is over US$50 even in September and October ($60, $60, $60, $64, $79 for full-hookup sites, RV Life reviews dated Aug-Oct 2026), and the resort FAQ adds an 8% resort fee to each reservation; RV Life rates it $$$.
name: Cedar Shore Campground
flags: Price was not read from the operator: cedarshoreresort.com/lodging/campground (read 2026-11-22) posts no rate (the 2024 Wayback capture 20240619112450 of /lodge-amenities/campground posted none either, only 'For seasonal site rates, please call'); the StayNTouch engine cedarshorecampground.ibe.stayntouch.com (hotel 1747) answered 'No rooms available' / an empty list for 2027-04-15, 05-20, 06-15, 07-14 and 09-08 (2027 inventory apparently not loaded yet). The skip rests on the 2026 camper-reported rates: RV Life park 2591 reviews of Aug 2026 ($60, fifth wheel site 42 pull-through; $60 travel trailer), Sep 2026 ($60 site K42; $64 motorhome), Oct 2026 ($79 motorhome site 37). No spring rate was found; an April-May night at $50 or less would reverse the call.
Resort fee: cedarshoreresort.com/faqs (read 2026-11-22, under Hotel Policies) 'An 8% resort fee applies to each reservation'; whether the separately booked campground carries it is not stated.

Not usable as price evidence: RoverPass roverpass.com/c/cedar-shore-resort-oacoma-sd/ is unclaimed (no Instant/Request to Book; 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'; 'Starting Daily' RV full hookup $45); Campendium's last price paid is $50 from 2020; the Hipcamp 'land' page is a one-site placeholder with no price.

Mostly seasonal: the operator's campground map (Arrow_CS_Campground_Map_2021_FINAL.pdf, still linked from the campground page 2026-11-22) marks sites 1-30 'Seasonal Sites' and 31-46 'Daily Sites' (16 of 46 = 35% nightly, passes test 4 with the 10-50% caveat). Operator: 44 campsites, all full hookups (30/50 A, water, sewer, cable), RV-only, no tents, plus 8 sleeping cabins. 2024 page: open April 1 - October 15.

Google Maps 'Cedar Shore Campground' 4.3 from 96 reviews (pin 43.82698,-99.34518, phone 605-234-6376, read 2026-11-22); the resort's own listing is 4.1 from 1,089 (shared with the hotel). The 2021 map and some directories carry an older phone 605-734-5273 and the old name Arrowwood Cedar Shore.
Not in campgrounds.json by name or within ~8 km (nearest: 15756 American Creek 3.3 km, 5726 Dude Ranch LUA 6.9 km), checked 2026-11-22.

If AWH overrides the price call: pin 43.82692,-99.34500 sits on the camping loops between Shoreline Drive and Lake Francis Case (Esri imagery read 2026-11-22, rendered); the northeast (seasonal) pads and the riverside cabins back onto a sand/riprap strip ~20-30 m from the water, the daily sites 31-46 at the southwest end look ~30-60 m back; a full waterfront audit was not done. Open-Meteo elevation at the pin: 425 m.
